_: The game-ideas agent's memory (D-360): the ledger of what was proposed and what the owner answered, and the taste those answers taught. Managed by tools/agents/ideas.mjs.

taste.what: A new game credits its inspiration honestly on its cover page, with a link (Codenames, ColorSweeper, Junction Nine, Number Match, Shikaku), and the credit stays off the result screen.
A puzzle is deducible without guessing, and a hint costs points instead of being free.
A new game is tried first as a solo, Spanish-only lab prototype in Proyectos activos; it leaves the lab in the four languages and joins La Copa's pool with a 0-to-100 score, never ×1.5.
No configurable rule variants for the sake of options, and no phone opponent where playing alone does the job.
What brings people back is asked for quietly: a streak with wildcards, reminders the player chooses, a quiet link for comments, never a popup during a game.
Rule changes to La Copa's dropout (self-service comeback) and first-time guided boards were both declined: do not propose loosening D-347 or tutorial boards without a new reason.

ideas.title: La Copa: come back on your own once
ideas.evidence: La Copa participation falls from 90% on day 1 to 51% on day 7; 11 players went out after two days without playing (D-347) and 0 were brought back. The only way back today is the admin's «Devolver a la copa».
ideas.cost: One PR in La Copa: a one-time «Volver a la copa» button on the out player's own board (spends their single comeback, reusing players/<pid>/back), a Firebase rules change so the player may write it once, four languages, a demo scene and its paths.mjs screen. Amends D-347 (only the admin brings back).
ideas.prototype: Lab demo first (?test&demo=out with the button), Spanish only, then a flag on real cups for two weeks.
ideas.proof: Players brought back goes from 0 to at least a third of those out, and day-7 participation rises from 51% to 60% or more over the next 4 weeks.
ideas.recommendation: Yes: the drop is the biggest leak in the most played thing in the app, and the cost is one rule, not a new mode.
ideas.question: La Copa: let a player who went out come back on their own, once per cup?

history.why: Owner answered No on #556 (no comment); D-347 stands: only the admin brings a player back.

ideas.title: Tango: a guided first board
ideas.evidence: Tango solo: 65 starts, 15 finishes (23%, the lowest of all), 50 abandoned; yet finishers score a median of 100/100 in 0:59, and in La Copa it has the most abandons (4 of 29). Those who get it, get it fast: the wall is understanding the rules, not the puzzle.
ideas.cost: One PR in Tango: a first-time 4x4 board that teaches the two signs (= and x) and the three-in-a-row rule step by step, shown once per browser (localStorage), four languages. No engine change.
ideas.prototype: Lab copy of Tango with the guided board, Spanish only, compared against the published one.
ideas.proof: Tango's solo finish rate from 23% to 40% or more, and abandons per start down, in the 4 weeks after it ships.
ideas.recommendation: Yes: cheapest of the three, and the numbers say the puzzle is fine once it is understood.
ideas.question: Tango: try a short guided first board for new players?

ideas.title: Pips: dominoes on a board
ideas.evidence: No game-idea requests from players yet; the case is the house's own pattern: the number puzzles from the daily waves carry the solo plays (Queens 103, Tango 94, Bulls and Cows 95), and Pips is the NYT's newest daily puzzle. It needs no words (travels to the four languages), is deducible without guessing, takes 1 to 5 minutes and has easy/medium/hard sizes for a seed.
ideas.cost: The whole of docs/ADD-GAME.md: engine and generator with a unique-solution check and tests, solo mode with a daily seed, 0-to-100 scoring, panel signal, result screen, end-to-end scripts, its document, four languages, README and social card; then La Copa's pool (not the Gran Final, D-332). Three to four PRs.
ideas.prototype: A Spanish-only solo lab project in Proyectos activos (D-304), one daily board, with the cover page crediting NYT Pips.
ideas.proof: In the lab, a finish rate of 50% or more with 20+ starts within 3 weeks; after graduating, 40+ plays in its first 4 weeks (Zip's level).
ideas.recommendation: Yes, after the two above: it fits the house exactly, but it is the most expensive.

ideas.title: La Copa: otra semana con el mismo grupo
ideas.evidence: check, 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-31: cups active 15, created 13, sign-ups 98, participation 74%; La Copa is 392 of the games finished. Sharing: copa 49, invita 6 of 9312. Participation by day falls from 94% (day 1) to 51% (day 7). A group that finished a cup has to create a new one by hand and send the link again; no rematch exists for cups (rooms have one, D-322).
ideas.cost: One PR: a button on the cup's final summary for the admin, «Otra copa con este grupo», that creates the next cup (same settings, a new set of games drawn as today) and shows the invite link to resend to the same group; three languages; no new Firebase path beyond what creating a cup writes; one end-to-end script on the cup's final.
ideas.prototype: Behind its flag in /labs/ (D-395), Spanish only: the button appears only to lab browsers on a finished cup's summary.
ideas.proof: Cups created per week: from about 3 (13 in four weeks) to 5 or more, with at least a third of new cups coming from the button, read two rounds after it lands.
ideas.recommendation: Yes, in Labs: it is the cheapest way to turn a finished cup into the next week's habit, where the app's players already are.
ideas.question: Try «La Copa: otra semana con el mismo grupo» in the lab?

ideas.title: Mini Sudoku 6×6
ideas.evidence: The LinkedIn-wave games already here lead the solo list: Reinas 125 finished (3rd of all games), Tango 83, Zip 29; Loteo (Shikaku, numbers) finishes 100% of its 22 starts in the numbers variant. No game-idea reports this range. A number puzzle needs no translation (C-3) and is deducible without guessing, scored 0 to 100 by time and errors with a daily seed (D-97).
ideas.cost: The whole of docs/ADD-GAME.md: a generator with a unique-solution check and tests, the board, three languages, the panel signal, the result screen, end-to-end scripts, its document, README and social card. The lab step first is a Spanish-only page.
ideas.prototype: A lab game in Juegos en prueba (D-304), Spanish only, solo, daily seed, 0 to 100, credit on its cover page.
ideas.proof: In the lab: 20+ starts and a finish rate of 60% or more (Reinas is 68%), median under 3 minutes.
ideas.recommendation: Yes, in Labs: it is the most played daily-puzzle format worldwide, it travels with no words, and it fits the house's LinkedIn line.
ideas.inspiration: Sudoku (Number Place, Howard Garns, 1979; named by Nikoli), in the 6×6 daily form LinkedIn Games launched as Mini Sudoku in 2025: https://www.linkedin.com/games/mini-sudoku/
ideas.question: Try «Mini Sudoku 6×6» in the lab?
